articles.title: Loss of ADAR1 in tumours overcomes resistance to immune checkpoint blockade
articles.summary: ADAR1 loss reduces A-to-I editing of interferon-inducible RNA species; endogenous dsRNA is sensed by PKR and MDA5. PKR supports growth-inhibition phenotypes, while MDA5/MAVS supports IFN-beta secretion and tumour inflammation. ADAR1 loss overcomes resistance to PD-1 checkpoint blockade. This context has mixed Boolean structure: ADAR1 loss/dsRNA accumulation is a shared anchor, then MDA5/MAVS and PKR are distinct named sensor branches that can independently contribute downstream biology.
